what: Read-only reach check of R6 (main-4d48844 4d488449 -> S affe56e8, and kx3's overlay K e3ddc014) over the 6 development decks x 8 panel lists of the kx3 replay check (laptop session, Oct 29 UTC; git grep / show / diff and Python over git show output only; no build, no game, no git write).
method: 1. git diff --stat 4d488449 S -- engine/src engine/examples engine/Cargo.* (38 files; each assigned to a change below or unused by games). 2. git diff of every non-data file a replayed game can run, read in full (players/*, observation.rs, state/*, actions/* except the data, card_logic/*, deck.rs, effects.rs, move_generation_abilities.rs, the non-test hunks of hooks/core.rs); the data/arm files checked hunk by hunk with the new-set ids taken out. 3. The 14 list files (git show S:path) and kx3's pool (git show K:playout_pool.rs): card ids, set census, git grep for every name or set a change needs. 4. engine/database.json at 4d488449 v S, entry by entry; the added mechanic-map texts against every text of the lists' cards. 5. Whole-database scans at run time (CardId::iter): rare_candy.rs's tables recomputed at both commits from card_ids.rs order and database.json; their consumers read. 6. Hashing/ordering: derives of CardId, hasher crates and DefaultHasher (git grep). Scripts: relplan/r6/kxr_checks/c1-c16 in the session scratchpad.

incidental.what: rare_candy.rs builds STAGE1_LOOKUP / STAGE2_LOOKUP (name -> list of evolution names, one entry per printing) and RARE_CANDY_LOOKUP once, by iterating every CardId. The new printings with the same names (108 share a name with a card of the lists) lengthen the lists; get_highest_evolutions pushes each available Stage 2 card once per Stage 1 entry, so for a Basic it returns each one more often: Torchic 2 -> 4, Treecko 2 -> 5, Caterpie 3 -> 5, Frigibax 1 -> 3 (the other Basics of the lists have no Stage 2 line or are unchanged; the Stage 1 path and the Stage 2 lookups test membership with contains). As sets the tables are unchanged for every name of the lists; RARE_CANDY_LOOKUP only gains 6 pairs (Cosmog, Dratini, Froakie, Gible, Larvitar), none with a Basic of the lists.
incidental.consumers: value_functions.rs: evolution_targets (sorted by id; threat_candidates -> min_by_key, the first of equal candidates, and the form index is looked up again in the same list by threat_attacker_stage_and_types (nth) and kd_attacker (targets[form])); evolution_potential (fold max); the online score (element [0], the same first element); is_attacker (any); opening_class.rs (is_empty). None counts or averages the list.
incidental.verdict: reached in the rows of 06 and every row v t-blaziken, t-sceptile and t-suicune; no decision changes by reading

incidental.what: new enum variants: SimpleAction gains TakeTopDeckCardAndShuffle as its FIRST variant; Mechanic and TurnEffect gain one each; CardId gains 698 (3,879 -> 4,577), which shifts the discriminants of the P-A and P-B ids (B4b, SP1 and C1 are declared before them).
incidental.consumers: CardId derives Hash, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, EnumIter (no Ord); derived orders keep the old variants' relative order; no DefaultHasher, Fx or AHash hasher in engine/src or rl/strength/src (git grep); the CardId -> Card DATABASE is a HashMap used for lookups only; CardId::iter() at run time only in rare_candy.rs (X1)
incidental.verdict: cannot change a result by reading

gaps: Reach by reading and grep, not by trace: the development run's logs hold the deck seat's decisions only, so which sites a game actually ran is not known.

X1 is argued from the consumers' code (max / first / any / is_empty / min_by_key on identical repeats); the empirical support is the km3 rows of the Oct 28 lane, not kx3 games. kx3's play-outs call the same km3 evaluation, so the kx3 self-check (equal to the pin's in the night job) is the only kx3-side evidence before this check.

The seam's 'reached in every row' rests on Weakness going through the chokepoint (printed_weakness_application, any-of over the attacker's types); the other per-card sites are listed per list from the cards' texts, not traced.
Behaviour-neutral 'by reading' for R1, R2 and R5 assumes the database entries are the old ones; that was checked (0 of 3,879 differ).
The base of the check branch (S or main after the adoption) changes nothing above as long as it has S's engine/ tree and the same rl/strength sources and deck files; prepare.sh checks that.
summary: No R6 change can act in the 48 rows (and replay_c's row). Changes 3, 4, 6, 7, 8 and 9 need a card that no list and no pool list holds. Changes 1, 2 and 5 are reached (the seam's type reads in every row; arms of Copycat, Field Blower, Lucky Ice Pop, Flame Patch, Clemont, Quick-Grow Extract, Korrina, Mesagoza; km3's Flame Patch pricing) but return what main-4d48844 returned for single-type old cards whose data is unchanged. Two incidental paths (X1 rare_candy repeats; X2 new enum variants) change no decision by reading. rows.json names no row: all 202 kx3 and 202 km3 games are expected to replay exactly, and any changed game is a stop.
